reject.camp: Boulder Shelter — the last camp outside the national park
reject.reason: The route's own alternate way in reaches Crystal Basin via Constance Pass, and the reviewer KEEPS Home Lake on that basis. Home Lake sits on the north (Dungeness) side of the pass, so it is only 'on route' if the party comes in from the north, up the Upper Dungeness trail (WTA/ProTrails: Upper Dungeness -> Camp Handy -> Boulder Shelter -> Home Lake -> Constance Pass, 9.8 mi). That is shorter than the Dosewallips road walk and passes Boulder Shelter. Keeping Home Lake while removing Boulder Shelter contradicts itself. Either both stay or both go; the north approach is real, so both should stay.

Camp Windy is the camp on that trail where parties drop their packs.
